description: Summarize a crawl: total issue count, counts by severity and by category, and every distinct issue key with how many pages it affects plus up to five example URLs. Always call this before query_issues - it is small, it tells you which keys are worth drilling into, and it is what you should base a prioritized fix plan on. Omit session_id to summarize the account's most recent crawl.

session_id.description:
Crawl session id from list_crawls. Omit to use the most recent crawl in
the database.

name: issues_summary
